versions.changelog:
Initial release of Greek bank statement integration for OpenClaw.

- Supports file-based import and parsing of statements (CSV/Excel/PDF) from all major Greek banks: Alpha, NBG, Eurobank, and Piraeus.
- Transaction reconciliation, categorization, VAT detection, duplicate detection, and cross-account matching for Greek accounting needs.
- Exports in CSV, JSON, QuickBooks, and Xero-compatible formats; includes direct Xero API push option.
- No bank credentials or API access required—works with files exported from bank portals.
- Fully documented setup, command usage, and file structure for seamless OpenClaw integration.
